status: confirmatory configuration prepared; do not run before protocol commit
purpose: Single-body Pulse model confirmation; not a clinical dosing recommendation

challenge.carrier_fluid_behavior: The pinned Pulse revision adds drug mass from concentration and rate but does not add infusion fluid to the cardiovascular fluid system. The volume field controls reservoir depletion only.

hypernatremia.validity: Outcome after a valid baseline; do not exclude the run or change dose/analysis because of the sodium response.

outcomes.diuresis: retain as an outcome; do not exclude a valid challenged run
outcomes.irreversible_state: retain as outcome; preserve trace and report run termination
outcomes.repeatability: compare full requested numeric trajectories and event times; report every nonzero difference
outcomes.effect_interpretation: Report per-target route contrasts, absolute and relative estimates where defined, full trajectories, and repeat consistency. No post hoc significance/minimum-effect cutoff and no pooling when direction reverses.

interpretation: Model-level response contrast in one StandardMale body; no population or clinical inference.
